1use pdf_writer::writers::ExponentialFunction;
2use pdf_writer::{Finish, Name, Ref, Writer};
3
4use crate::third_party::krilla::chunk_container::ChunkContainer;
5use crate::third_party::krilla::color::separation::SeparationSpace;
6use crate::third_party::krilla::color::{DEVICE_CMYK, DEVICE_GRAY, DEVICE_RGB};
7use crate::third_party::krilla::resource::{self, Resource, Resourceable};
8use crate::third_party::krilla::serialize::{Cacheable, MaybeDeviceColorSpace, SerializeContext};
9
10#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Hash, Clone)]
11pub(crate) struct SeparationColorSpace {
12    space: SeparationSpace,
13}
14
15impl SeparationColorSpace {
16    pub fn new(space: SeparationSpace) -> Self {
17        Self { space }
18    }
19}
20
21impl Cacheable for SeparationColorSpace {
22    fn serialize(self, sc: &mut SerializeContext, chunk_container: &mut ChunkContainer, root_ref: Ref) {
23        // Delegate fallback color space registration to existing logic
24        let fallback_cs = self.space.fallback.color_space(sc);
25        let fallback_cs_resource = sc.register_colorspace(chunk_container, fallback_cs.into());
26
27        // Get fallback color components for tint function
28        let fallback_color = crate::third_party::krilla::color::Color::from(self.space.fallback).to_pdf_color();
29        let num_components = fallback_color.len();
30
31        // Determine C0 based on whether the fallback is subtractive or additive
32        // - Additive (RGB, Luma): tint 0.0 = white = [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]
33        // - Subtractive (CMYK): tint 0.0 = white = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
34        let c0_value = if self.space.fallback.is_subtractive() { 0.0 } else { 1.0 };
35
36        if let Err(validation_error) = sc.validation_store().validate_separation(&self.space) {
37            sc.register_validation_error(validation_error);
38        }
39
40        let chunk = &mut chunk_container.non_stream.color_spaces;
41
42        // Write Separation color space array: [/Separation name alternateSpace tintTransform]
43        let mut array = chunk.indirect(root_ref).array();
44        array.item(Name(b"Separation"));
45
46        // Colorant name
47        array.item(self.space.colorant.to_pdf());
48
49        // Fallback color space - write as name for device CS, or ref for others
50        match fallback_cs_resource {
51            MaybeDeviceColorSpace::DeviceRgb => array.item(Name(DEVICE_RGB.as_bytes())),
52            MaybeDeviceColorSpace::DeviceGray => array.item(Name(DEVICE_GRAY.as_bytes())),
53            MaybeDeviceColorSpace::DeviceCMYK => array.item(Name(DEVICE_CMYK.as_bytes())),
54            MaybeDeviceColorSpace::ColorSpace(cs) => {
55                // Use get_ref() to extract the underlying Ref
56                array.item(cs.get_ref())
57            }
58        };
59
60        // Write Type 2 (Exponential) function for tint transform
61        // Maps tint [0.0-1.0] from white (no ink) to fallback color (full ink)
62        ExponentialFunction::start(array.push())
63            .domain([0.0, 1.0])
64            .range([0.0, 1.0].repeat(num_components))
65            // C0: white/no ink (tint = 0.0) - value depends on color space
66            .c0(vec![c0_value; num_components])
67            // C1: fallback color (tint = 1.0)
68            .c1(fallback_color)
69            .n(1.0);
70
71        array.finish();
72    }
73}
74
75impl Resourceable for SeparationColorSpace {
76    type Resource = resource::ColorSpace;
77}
